answer_1.quote: this paper introduces WAFFLE, a fine-tuning pipeline specifically designed for UI images to HTML code generation

answer_2.quote: We evaluate WAFFLE using two test datasets: WebSight-Test, which consists of synthetic webpages, and Design2Code... We adopt CLIP and Low-Level Element Matching (LLEM) metrics from previous work. Additionally, we introduce two new metrics: HTML-Match... and complex wavelet structural similarity index (CW-SSIM)

answer_4.quote: Human Evaluation. Two human annotators are asked to compare the rendered webpages generated by different techniques from a subset of test data with the ground-truth webpage and rank them.
answer_4.guideline: rank the generated webpages based on similarity to the ground-truth webpage
